title: The Holiday Trip
audience: Chinese primary school students (10-12 years old, average level in mainland China)
imageAlt: A family waiting on a train platform for the 10:00 train to Haikou, with an open suitcase of holiday things
imageDescription: A sunny day at a railway station platform. A big blue sign reads TRAIN TO HAIKOU 10:00. On the right, a tall platform clock shows 9:30. A friendly green train with a smiling face is stopped at the platform. In the front, a girl with twin ponytails, yellow shirt and pink backpack holds up a white ticket card that reads BEIJING, an arrow, HAIKOU, 10:00. Beside her, Dad in a blue polo shirt holds an open red suitcase showing a colorful swim ring, a black camera and a straw sun hat. Mum in a pink top, purple skirt and straw hat smiles while holding an open paper map. The platform has a yellow safety line, blue sky with white clouds, and green trees in the distance.
scoringDescription: A bright cartoon railway platform on a sunny day. A large blue overhead sign reads TRAIN TO HAIKOU 10:00, so the train to Haikou departs at ten o'clock. At the upper right a big round platform clock shows 9:30 (hour hand between 9 and 10, minute hand at 6), meaning the family still has thirty minutes before departure. A green train with a cute smiling face is stopped at the platform behind the family. In front, a happy girl with black twin ponytails tied with red beads, yellow shirt, blue jeans and pink backpack holds a white card like a ticket: BEIJING on top, a blue arrow pointing right, HAIKOU below, and 10:00 at the bottom - the train goes from Beijing to Haikou. To the left, Dad in a blue polo shirt with a black backpack strap holds an open red suitcase on wheels; inside are a pink-yellow-blue swim ring, a black camera and a straw sun hat with a blue band and yellow flower, plus folded blue clothes. In the middle, Mum in a pink top, purple skirt, straw hat with pink band and yellow earrings holds an open paper map with green land and blue sea. The platform edge has a yellow safety line; sky is blue with small clouds and green trees appear on both sides. Evidence for the destination: the blue sign, the girl's BEIJING-to-HAIKOU card, and the warm-weather items (swim ring, sun hat, camera) suggest a beach holiday in Haikou. The swim ring and sun hat show they are going somewhere warm. They are waiting, not boarding yet, because it is still 9:30 and the train leaves at 10:00.
